title: Recommendation Engine
short_description: Learn how recommendation systems use Trie operations, Two Pointer techniques, Three Sum, Sliding Window, and Power Set concepts to generate relevant item combinations efficiently.

real_world_context.problem: A recommendation platform needs to analyze user preferences and available items to generate relevant suggestions, find compatible item combinations, identify high-scoring groups, and explore possible recommendation configurations efficiently.
real_world_context.why_it_matters: Efficient searching, combination, and window-based algorithms allow recommendation systems to process large collections of items and generate useful suggestions without unnecessary computation.

learning_objectives: Understand how Trie structures support prefix-based product recommendations.
Apply Two Pointer techniques to find pairs of items satisfying a target condition.
Use Three Sum techniques to identify valid three-item recommendation bundles.
Apply Sliding Window techniques to analyze continuous groups of recommendation scores.
Understand how a Power Set represents all possible combinations of available items.
Understand how sorting can improve the efficiency of pair and triplet searching.
Choose an appropriate algorithm based on the type of recommendation problem being solved.
Understand why algorithm efficiency matters when processing large collections of products and user preferences.

real_world_mapping.product_name: String representing the name of an available item
real_world_mapping.category_prefix: Starting sequence used to search for relevant products
real_world_mapping.item_score: Numerical value representing an item's recommendation score
real_world_mapping.target_score: Desired combined score for a recommendation or bundle
real_world_mapping.recommendation_pair: Two items whose scores satisfy a target condition
real_world_mapping.recommendation_bundle: Three items whose combined scores satisfy a target condition
real_world_mapping.recommendation_window: Continuous group of item scores analyzed together
real_world_mapping.recommendation_configuration: One possible subset of available recommendation items

completion_message: You have completed the Recommendation Engine mission. You have learned how Trie operations, Two Pointer techniques, Three Sum, Sliding Window, and Power Set concepts can be applied to product search, recommendation bundles, score analysis, and recommendation configuration generation.
